title: Combat journal is bounded but remains quadratic and semantically incomplete
controls_verified: 32 MiB journal, 64 KiB line, 32768 record, and JSON depth 16 ceilings exist
bounded descriptor reads and strict resource/schema parsing reject deep and oversized journal input
record exhaustion fails append instead of permitting unbounded allocation

reproduction.tail_semantics: With 5001 synthetic live commits, real list_actions/undo_all selection attempted only 5000 and omitted the oldest.
reproduction.append_cost: Four consecutive 25-record append windows took 1.4735, 1.8975, 1.9896, and 2.2606 seconds in an inert temporary journal.
reproduction.capacity_boundary: Source review confirms no worst-case terminal byte/record reservation before an intent can consume the last available slot.

recommendation: Add authenticated immutable segments/checkpoints and a transactionally updated complete live-action index; reserve worst-case terminal and rollback capacity before every intent; use full live state for reconciliation and undo while keeping limits only for display.
required_gates: 501 active actions all rebuild on restart
5001 reversible actions are all attempted by undo_all
near-byte and near-record ceilings refuse before the host effect
crash-safe rotation/compaction preserves live and recovery records
append latency is independent of terminal-history length

title: Quarantine accepts a hard-linked object and can commit after alias drift
controls_verified: source content and identity are read through a pinned handle
Windows denies write/delete sharing while the handle is retained
no-follow parent traversal and no-replace move checks resist path swaps
a post-move digest check occurs before custody is released

reproduction.alias_survival: A two-link temporary file was moved successfully; the original name disappeared but the alternate alias remained readable with the same file identity.
reproduction.terminal_drift: Mutating the surviving alias after pinned.close and before _commit_after_mutation produced an authenticated applied commit whose receipt SHA-256 did not match the quarantine destination.

recommendation: Require and receipt-bind link count one at enrollment, pre-effect, post-move, and pre-commit; retain exact file and directory custody through the terminal; provide same-handle rollback; protect the quarantine namespace; reject cross-volume alias-unsafe moves.
required_gates: pre-existing Windows and POSIX hard links fail before intent/effect
link introduction at each transaction boundary is denied or detected
alias mutation between postcondition and commit cannot produce success
cross-volume copy/delete proves one-link source and destination
undo/restart never authorizes an alias-mismatched receipt

title: AV Telemetry Bridge still discards retained Defender detections without restart continuity
controls_verified: Defender event XML is bounded and parsed with defusedxml
event-log read errors lower health transiently
PowerShell fallback is explicitly labeled lower fidelity

reproduction.retained_restart: Two independent fake starts each supplied one retained EID 1116. Both silently drained it, processed zero records, and reported health 100.
reproduction.state_review: No durable bookmark, generation anchor, stable record identity, gap record, pending delivery batch, or fallback DetectionID cursor exists.

recommendation: Use bounded modern WEVT queries with an authenticated generation/anchor/bookmark cursor and a durable at-least-once pending outbox; replay retained/unacknowledged identities, persist fallback delivery state, close handles, and keep every continuity gap below health 100.
required_gates: retained detection before first start is delivered or explicitly gapped
restart after and before delivery acknowledgement is at least once
clear/refill, record reuse, retention loss, and read reopen persist gaps
cursor rollback/tamper fails incomplete
fallback restart and failures retain exact counters and degraded health

title: Deception discloses missing read coverage but still emits one false access claim and has no read observer
controls_verified: module docstring and description now scope coverage to mutation/deletion
live health is capped at 70 or 45 with the exact missing audited-read reason
personal-folder and registry lures remain explicit opt-in

reproduction.plain_read: Reading a temporary registered canary left mtime unchanged and emitted zero alerts.
reproduction.remaining_claim: A real generated lure contained 'Any access is logged & isolated'; reading it left the baseline unchanged and emitted zero alerts.
reproduction.registry: The registry helper only runs reg add and has no read subscription.

recommendation: Remove the remaining any-access claim immediately. For full capability, require explicit audited mode with verified audit policy/SACL, exact file and registry identities, actor process generation, bounded restart-safe telemetry, dedupe, and health 100 only while read visibility is proven.
required_gates: ordinary file read and registry query each produce one object-bound alert
same-path replacement cannot inherit decoy authority
wrong-object, wrong-actor, and replayed audit records fail
missing audit source/policy/cursor remains below health 100
restart replays retained reads and self-reads do not false-trip

title: Driver provenance remains a mutable configured-path sample without loaded-image binding
controls_verified: inventory, output, row, and image-size bounds are explicit
missing and truncated evidence is non-green
the PowerShell executable path is resolved through the trusted path helper
HVCI/Secure Boot posture is joined and the module is observe-only
ordinary bundled blocklist non-match remains unknown rather than safe

reproduction.schema_acceptance: A complete synthetic evidence object containing no file/load binding fields was assessed as provenance-verified with evidence_complete=true.
reproduction.source_review: The provider derives running state from Win32_SystemDriver, tokenizes service name plus basename, and performs Get-Item/Get-FileHash/Get-AuthenticodeSignature/Get-Item as separate mutable path operations.

recommendation: Classify the current provider as unbound configured-path sampling. Require a mandatory binding state; pin/hash/catalog-verify one exact disk object; and accept exact loaded provenance only from a monotonic native/kernel load receipt binding boot/load generation, module base/size, Code Integrity result, and backing file identity/digest.
required_gates: post-load benign disk replacement remains unbound
same-size/same-timestamp hash-signature swap fails
leaf/parent reparse and hard-link objects fail
service-running without loaded-module receipt cannot claim running provenance
path reuse across load generations is distinct
no unbound evidence can produce provenance-verified
